images.filename: Loreto City Hall (42646547462).jpg
images.caption:
The city of Loreto is the seat of the Municipality of Loreto, which is governed by a City Council (Ayuntamiento), consisting of a Mayor or Municipal President (Presidente Municipal), a Syndic (Síndico), and six City Councilors (Regidores), all eight elected by direct popular vote for a mandatory single term limit of three years. The Mayor is a voting member of the council, and as head of the public municipal administration is directly responsible for actual implementation of the City Council’s decisions, somewhat analogous to a City Manager.

The Municipality was created in 1992 and Loreto citizens elected their first Mayor (Municipal President) in 1993. The Federal Electoral Institute, as of February 3, 2008, recorded 9,073 registered voters for the Municipality of Loreto.

images.filename: Hotel Posada de Las Flores (35411315672) (cropped).jpg
images.caption:
This beautiful hotel features a glass-bottom swimming pool on a rooftop terrace that overlooks the Sea of Cortés and the Giganta Mountains. The beach is only 200 metres away.
Posada de las Flores Loreto is located in the centre of Loreto, next to the main square and the Misión de Nuestra Señora de Loreto Temple. It features colonial Mexican décor with 18th-century furniture, talavera pottery and exposed beams.
The spiral central staircase gives a unique feel to this hotel and the open seating area downstairs feels just like home.
